clarification: agent-exit and caller-exit deliberately close their respective actual D-Bus connections in the same witness process; the bus emits real NameOwnerChanged/loss.

The witness process remains alive to validate the other role/new caller and subsequent business. These gates prove unique-bus-owner loss handling, not separate Agent/requester SIGKILL, fork/inherited bus descriptor or exec semantics.
The caller-exit gate does not read the original private terminal; it checks fresh allocation/cancel with distinct IDs, old-query AccessDenied, zero security wire and subsequent app replies.
Application payload checks/replies run in separate ordinary channel applications; they are actual device business, not callbacks/method echo.
No retroactive change to raw captures, old failures or original report identity. Separate process death/fd inheritance/admin revocation deployment/inflight tests remain open.
